description:
FILED s473w (Opus, 2026-09-09) from the #1502 CPAN-board census.

`IO::Socket::UNIX` calls `AF_UNIX` (imported from Socket) and PCL dies

    Undefined subroutine &IO::Socket::UNIX::AF_UNIX called

so any program that so much as LOADS IO::Socket::UNIX is lost.  On the board
that is Data-Dump t/glob.t, FAIL 0/0 where perl gives 6 rows â the file merely
dumps a socket handle among its globs.

REPRODUCE:
    tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/Data-Dump-1.25-0 t/glob.t
and, smaller:
    perl -e 'use IO::Socket::UNIX; print "loaded\n"'   # perl: loaded
    ./runpcl <the same as a file>                      # PCL: dies

LAYER (CLAUDE.md 9a): `Socket` is a core module with an XS half, and PCL has
`lib/Socket.pm` as a shim.  The constant is a MODULE FACT, so the fix is in
that shim's export list / constant table, not in the parser or runtime.  Check
what `lib/Socket.pm` exports today against what `IO::Socket::UNIX` imports
(`AF_UNIX`, `PF_UNIX`, `SOCK_STREAM`, `SOCK_DGRAM`, `SOMAXCONN`, â¦) and add the
missing ones with their platform values â the same way the shim already
carries the AF_INET family.

CHEAP AND WORTH IT: one shim edit, one guard row, six board rows.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: NARROWED -- the filed failure is gone; a different, narrower one is left.
PASS (= perl 5.40.3): `use IO::Socket::UNIX` loads ; `use Socket qw(AF_UNIX PF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM SOCK_DGRAM SOMAXCONN)` -> 1 1 1 2 ; the raw
  `socket(my $s, AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0)` + `bind($s, pack_sockaddr_un($path))` -> 1 / 1 and the socket file exists ; #1615's shapes
  (`require IO::Socket`, `require IO::Socket::INET` alone, `require IO::Socket::UNIX`, `Symbol::gensym`) -> loaded / GLOB.
  The Data-Dump glob.t board row this was filed for passes since s521d (#3516, its one-file run 6/0).
FAILS: `IO::Socket::UNIX->new(Type => SOCK_STREAM, Local => $path, Listen => 1)` -> undef, $! = 2 (ENOENT), $@ empty; perl answers an
  IO::Socket::UNIX object.  The suspect: the IO::Socket::UNIX / IO::Socket configure path (sockaddr_un or the Local address handling),
  since the builtins under it work.
MERGE: #1615 (s481b's "CORRECTION to #1574") is closed INTO this task; its load-path shapes are recorded above (all = perl now).
LABEL: loud -- the constructor reports failure (a program's `or die` or the next method call on undef stops it); not a silent wrong.
subject: LOUD (a constructor that fails): `IO::Socket::UNIX->new(Type => SOCK_STREAM, Local => $path, Listen => 1)` returns undef ($! ENOENT) where perl creates the listening socket; loading IO::Socket / ::INET / ::UNIX and AF_UNIX are fixed (#1615 merged here)
triage_reason: Socket does not export AF_UNIX (one task with #1615) -- verify
